_comment: Who may run the official-edge key ceremony (`losos-registrar provision`),
compiled into the binary. The tool signs the operator in with GitHub's
OAuth device flow and refuses to make or sign anything unless the
signed-in account's numeric id is listed here. The id is the key: logins
can be renamed, ids cannot. Keep the login beside it for readability.
github_oauth_client_id is the public client id of the project's GitHub
OAuth App (Settings > Developer settings > OAuth Apps, with Device Flow
enabled); it is not a secret and no client secret exists for this flow.

operators.note: Matus, project owner (the account was dichhead until 2026-09-30)
